data.content_ref: inline:This conjecture integrates SRC_005 with SRC_002: a node is standing-suspended (no path of length ≤ k to an accepted defender) if and only if it admits no DefenseWitness within the k-bounded neighbourhood of the accepted set, so the standing-residue report and the DefenseWitness construction share one mechanism — bounded BFS from the accepted nodes — and can be computed in a single post-fixpoint pass at O(V+E) for fixed k. REFUTED IF one exhibits a node that is standing-suspended yet has an accepted defender at distance ≤ k, or a node that carries a DefenseWitness and is nonetheless standing-suspended under the bounded-BFS definition.
